rate_table_note: Rates are in 45-07-01.1-04(1)(a), written in words (sixty-two cents; one dollar five cents). Single premium rates come from the formula in (1)(b) and are not published as figures. The April 1, 2021 amendment corrected the formula only.
source_title: N.D. Admin. Code chapter 45-07-01.1, Consumer Credit Insurance (effective January 1, 2003)
summary: Rates in force: North Dakota's credit life prima facie rates in N.D. Admin. Code 45-07-01.1-04, effective January 1, 2003: 62 cents per month per $1,000 of outstanding insured debt (single) and $1.05 (joint). No triennial adjustment under 45-07-01.1-09 was found.
